title: Volkstelling 1971 public use files (beveiligde 1%-steekproeven uit de microdata)
authors: Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (primary investigator)
contributors: Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (data collector)
descriptions: Reconstruction of the Census of 1971, anonymised 1% samples from the microdata files. Selected variables: sex, age according to 5-year classes, country of citizenship, marital status, household position, religious denomination, country of birth, household size, economic status, level of educational attainment, occupation, branch of current economic activity.
